text: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Earth makes it steady, so what you claim lasts. In balance, firm ground holds under each new reach. Whatever you chase, something solid stays under your feet.

Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Metal makes it exact, so what you take on ends finished or not at all. In balance, what you take on matches the strength you have for it. Your reach and your means keep the same pace.

Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Water gives it a current, and you gain most on the move. In balance, the current moves at your pace. You go out and come back at a steady rhythm.
A race wakes you up like nothing else. Someone running beside you is your best fuel, since a pace you can see beats one you must invent. What you want is a rival worth racing.

Seek Earth, the Action energy. Earth is bank and field, the ground that gives rain somewhere to stop and something to grow. Let it settle what Water keeps pouring in. No amount of knowing decides for you. Make one choice this week and act on it the same day. Fix one broken thing with your own hands.
You take people in, spare bed and all. A safe place is what you want most, and making one for others comes easier than finding your own. Friends in a bad week know where to come.

Seek Wood, your own Body energy. Wood is the trunk under everything you reach for, the body that stands before it carries. Let it hold what Earth piles up. Your load has grown past what you can bear. Start each week by clearing out one thing you no longer use. Say no to one request before you say yes again.

On a shared stake, you bet someone else's year with your own. You would rather win big for everyone in it than keep half safe, and their doubts only push you further. You take whoever is in it with you through every swing.

Your first reply to someone's new idea is what worked last time. A tested answer feels kinder to you than an untried one, and you give it before you hear them out. You send them off with your answer in place of theirs.
You set a standard for the whole group. You would rather people see the bar than guess at it, and you meet it yourself before you ask it of them. Your group works to a mark it had no say in choosing.
Paying for everyone feels like winning to you. You would rather cover the whole bill than split it, even with money you pooled with friends. Along with the money, you spend a plan you made together.

You are spread so thin that no one thing gets enough of you. Saying no feels like losing, so you hold many small pieces rather than one whole thing. You have every right to drop a few and give one your all.

Saying too much is the honesty you were built for. A thought left unsaid feels like a lie to you, so you say the whole thing rather than the useful half. Stopping at the half that helps is honest too.

Spending on the people you love comes no easier than spending on yourself. Giving less feels safer than giving more, and you cut back on them as hard as on yourself. You take what you save out of their share.
As a catalyst, few of those demands reach you. You look for a standard worth meeting, and rank comes slowly through proof.

The people closest to you are the first you look past. Getting to the next venture matters more to you than being with them, so you give them what is left. You keep your full attention from them, even on evenings you share.

In meetings you wait your turn to speak, and the idea waits with you. Speaking first feels like putting yourself above others, and the talk moves on before your turn comes. You walk out with the idea that would have helped them.

Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal makes it exact, each thing finished before it leaves you. In balance, the gate opens when a piece is ready and closes when you need to rest. You give out no faster than you refill.

Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is fuel that grows: it drinks the rain and turns it into something a fire can burn. Let it use what Water pours on you. You take every rule to heart and grow nothing of your own. Begin one thing this month that is only yours. Leave it off every list.
Your bets carry other people's names. You would rather share a risk than carry it alone, and that puts their money where your nerve is. Their savings rise and fall with your choices.

Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it a reach that keeps going once started. Running over, your push outgrows every shared plan, because your own way is the one you trust. You press on without checking who is still beside you.

Whenever the people close to you run short, you are generous before being asked. A gift ties you down less than a shared plan, and you give instead of building something together. Nobody near you goes without for long.

Putting comfort first gets you through a hard week. Because the easy choice calms you now and the right one pays later, you choose ease over effort. You let good chances go by to stay comfortable, and few come back.

You make the people who love you prove it first. Trusting early feels like handing someone the means to hurt you, and proof has to come before closeness. You leave them all the work of getting near you.

Whenever someone near you wants something, you are already saving. Because safety together matters more than happiness today, you set saving above the wish. Nobody close to you has to worry about next month.

Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Wood makes it grow, a standard rising with you. In balance, what is asked of you fits the life you are building. You meet each new demand at a steady pace.

Seek Metal, the Action energy. Metal is the finished line, the point where a thing is decided and sent on its way. Let it spend what Wood piles up. You keep what you take in, ideas and people alike, because letting go seems like losing. Close one open question this week. Send one idea out before it is polished.

Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Wood makes it grow, so what you build adds up. In balance, your hunger to build has strength under it. In a lean stretch, you slow down and still grow.

Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire makes it warm, so what you build reaches people in time. In balance, the fire burns steady. Whether you reach for something new or hold on to the old, the warmth stays.
A race gets all of you moving. You come alive with a rival in sight, and chasing a real person drives you harder than any plan. Your best work shows up with someone fast at your shoulder.
Whenever you make the work look easy, people learn from the look alone. Your first try already looks right, and they see the ease without the care behind it. You pass on the ease but never the care.
As a catalyst, the edge runs thin. You see more openings than you have the means to take.

Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Earth makes it steady, so what you learn sinks in. As a catalyst, the ground runs short, and new things pass through before they settle. Only what you work through yourself stays with you.

Seek Water, your own Body energy. Water is the deep you draw from, the sleep and food and slow fill that come before anything is lit. Let it cool what Fire burns. Whether you are reaching for more or guarding what you have, the heat comes out of your own reserves. Eat before any big choice. Let the numbers wait.

Being hard on yourself is a rule you never had to learn. Every standard turns into a judge in you, and you would rather fail your own hard test than pass someone else's easy one. Underneath, you want to hear that you did well.

You pass the need for permission to whoever comes to you. A yes only counts once someone else gives it, and you send their questions on unanswered. You leave them waiting on a permission you were free to give.
Where you avoid change, you avoid it for others too. You keep the people close to you inside the old plan instead of letting them change it. They miss the new starts they wanted to make.

Spread thin, you never learn what full effort can do. You stay spread over shallow ventures rather than deep in one, since the one you skipped always looks better. You pay in rest never taken and in the one venture that would have paid.

You spot the opening when it is only a gap. A distant chance thrills you more than a near one, and you spot a newer opening while you are claiming this one. Your eye finds a door where everyone else sees a wall.

A bar you set yourself never lets you rest. Because the standard is yours, you raise it rather than meet it, and the mark moves each time you near it. Your wins go by uncelebrated, since none of them was ever the goal.

For you, competing with someone is how you take them seriously. You raise the stakes because a rival worth beating means more to you than easy company. Your friends rarely get a game with you that is only a game.

Going first is where your boldness lives. Coming second feels like losing, and you jump in before reading the plan with your own savings on the line. Your bank balance carries the lessons everyone after you gets for free.

Seek Earth, the Order energy. Earth is the bank: it gives moving water a path and a shore. Let it shape what your Water pours. Without a shore your strength either piles up into weight or spills over. Before Sunday, finish one job you have put off. Keep the same day each week for one steady task.

When someone close to you is upset, you become the calm for both. Feeling held matters more to you than being known, and your own trouble never shows. The people you shelter seldom get the chance to look after you.
